name: Nob
overview: Nob was a city of the tribe of Benjamin known as "the city of the priests," serving as the residence of Ahimelech the priest and likely the location of the tabernacle during Saul's reign. In 1 Samuel 21, David comes to Nob seeking aid and is provided with consecrated bread, highlighting the city's sacred function and the priestly role of Ahimelech. This passage illustrates Nob's significance as a spiritual refuge for David before its eventual destruction by Saul.
